name: spec-review-yaml-schema-roundtrip
description: v1.6 LLD-007 — pipe canned valid YAML attestation to cli.spec_review; verify exit 0, attestation written under docs/reviews/, schema-valid, hash recomputed, path canonical.

exercise.cmd:
